metadata.description: Built GTM playbooks: runnable multi-skill GTM workflows, each a guide plus the skills to run it. From builtgtm.ai.

plugins.name: build-ai-native-gtm
plugins.description: Build the AI-Native GTM Operating System - A workflow you framed instead of a hire, a context repo any agent can use, a signal wired to a booked motion, and a closed loop where the outcome changes the next action

plugins.name: book-a-meeting
plugins.description: Book a meeting at a target account - A scored target, a timely reason to reach out, and a multi-channel sequence that gets a reply

plugins.name: run-a-deal
plugins.description: Run a deal from discovery to signature - A qualified deal, a buyer-specific demo, a business case, and a dated path to signed

plugins.name: win-the-competitive-deal
plugins.description: Win a deal against an incumbent - A clear read on the deal, a battlecard, a real champion, and a business case that lands

plugins.name: save-a-renewal
plugins.description: Save an at-risk renewal - An early verdict, the real reason, the right levers, and a save sequence with exit criteria

plugins.name: grow-an-account
plugins.description: Find and land the next expansion - A book-level read, the usage signals, the play, and an executive ask that gets a yes

plugins.name: onboard-a-customer
plugins.description: Get a new customer to value, and keep them - A goal-tied plan, an adoption habit, a first-90-day read, and a QBR that earns the renewal

plugins.name: score-the-market
plugins.description: Score the whole market, then work the top - A fit verdict per account, a stack rank, a target list, and a per-lead work plan

plugins.name: fix-the-funnel
plugins.description: Find the funnel leak and fix it - The leak named, the metrics pinned, the coverage math, and a coaching plan per rep

plugins.name: learn-from-every-close
plugins.description: Turn closed deals into a repeatable edge - What wins share, why losses happen, a coded pattern, and a change you can ship

plugins.name: weekly-revenue-cadence
plugins.description: Run the weekly revenue cadence - A revenue read, a pipeline read, a defensible forecast, and a one-screen digest

plugins.name: ramp-a-rep
plugins.description: Ramp a new rep to quota, fast - A scorecard before the hire, a 30/60/90 ramp, and coaching that catches a slow start early

plugins.name: launch-a-product
plugins.description: Take a product or feature to market - Positioning, a tiered launch plan, the content, a demand plan, and earned media

plugins.name: get-found-in-ai
plugins.description: Get found in the AI era (AEO/GEO) - Real customer language, sharp positioning, an AEO audit, and content built to be quoted

plugins.name: build-your-operator-system
plugins.description: Build your operator system - A context pack, a decision log, runbooks, a safe closeout, and a system that improves itself

plugins.name: icp-playbook
plugins.description: Nail your ICP, then act on it - The real ICP from won-customer patterns, a fit score per account, a stack rank, and the channel to work each tier

plugins.name: persona-playbook
plugins.description: Find and message your core personas - The personas that matter, who to interview, a message house per persona, and discovery that fits them

plugins.name: gtm-plan
plugins.description: Build a GTM plan you can defend - A verdict-first plan: the bets, the capacity math, fair territories, and comp that drives the right behavior

plugins.name: ai-native-motion
plugins.description: Stand up an AI-native GTM motion - A scored market, enriched accounts, a product-usage read, a QA agent that watches it, and a loop that learns

plugins.name: diagnose-the-miss
plugins.description: Diagnose why you are missing the number - The leak named, the deals that are real, the pattern underneath, and a defensible forecast

plugins.name: reprice-to-derisk-revenue
plugins.description: Reprice to de-risk your revenue - A value metric, clean tiers, a plan for the free base, and the modeled impact before you change a thing

plugins.name: win-the-committee
plugins.description: Win the whole buying committee - A real champion, a read on every open deal, the relationship pulse, and a dated close plan

plugins.name: build-a-partner-channel
plugins.description: Build a partner channel that produces pipeline - The right partners, a first joint motion, a named-account co-sell, and events that convert

plugins.name: revops-foundation
plugins.description: Stand up the RevOps foundation - A clean CRM, pinned funnel metrics, routing that gets built, and a stack with the overlap cut

plugins.name: win-back-churned
plugins.description: Win back churned logos - The real churn theme, a save angle, and a timely, relevant re-open on the accounts worth it

plugins.name: content-engine
plugins.description: Run the content engine - The real language, writer-ready briefs, a growing audience, and pages an answer engine will quote

plugins.name: founder-led-sales
plugins.description: Run founder-led sales, then hand it off - A repeatable discovery and outreach motion, and the scorecard and ramp to hand it to your first hires

plugins.name: ep1-run-the-loop
plugins.description: Run the GTM loop on one workflow - One workflow reframed as work, a buy-vs-build call per step, and the drag split from the judgment

plugins.name: ep2-build-context-repo
plugins.description: Build your GTM context repo this week - A context pack any teammate or agent can start from, a greppable knowledge base, and a clean workspace

plugins.name: ep3-signal-to-motion
plugins.description: Wire a signal to a booked motion - A scored signal, a timely touch, routing that lands it, and the output written back where it belongs

plugins.name: ep4-close-the-loop
plugins.description: Close the loop so GTM compounds - A measurement model finance accepts, a QA layer that watches it, and a loop where outcomes change the next action

plugins.name: win-back-the-churned
plugins.description: Win back a churned customer - a scored onboarding experience, a scored exit, the churned accounts worth chasing, and a warm re-onboarding sequence

plugins.name: superhuman-docs-operator-pack
plugins.description: Build docs in Superhuman Docs (Coda) that look senior, not junior - the design system, the MCP build mechanics, and the planning framework behind them

plugins.name: work-the-deal-signals
plugins.description: Work the deal signals before the forecast slips - A standing watch on every account in play, a same-week play for every job change and hiring signal, wider coverage on the deals that matter, and a win profile that feeds the next list
